cohort: The study included 264 pregnant women, 261 partners, and 266 infants from birth to 1 month of age.
finding: Delivery mode significantly influences early gut and oral microbiota composition, with vaginal delivery associated with taxa also found in maternal samples.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery influences early gut and oral microbiota composition, leading to an enrichment of Lactobacillus crispatus in meconium and Blautia_A in oral swabs within 48 hours of birth in vaginally delivered infants.
